scope: Technical capability and production-state audit only. Pedagogical coverage decisions belong to gap-analysis-pedagogical.json; the final gap-analysis.json must reconcile both audits.

executive_summary.current_strength: Recovery already has a mature topic-level learning and evidence stack: 24 active topics, four published phases per topic, adaptive plan sessions, topic mastery evidence, cumulative-session materialization hooks, readiness snapshots and a broad Exercise Builder question renderer.
executive_summary.primary_gap: Curriculum v2 cannot yet become runtime truth because Recovery production has no first-class outcome_id, competence_axis, assessment_mode, independence or unseen-context evidence model. Existing Recovery state is keyed primarily by topic_key.
executive_summary.content_runtime_gap: There are 96 active topic-phase mappings in production (24 recover, 24 practice, 24 school, 24 verify) and zero active checkpoint, mock_intermediate, mock_final or error_review mappings.
executive_summary.engine_reuse_conclusion: Do not build a second exercise engine. Exercise Builder already supports the task families needed for Curriculum v2; extend Recovery metadata, evidence capture and cumulative materialization around the existing engine.
executive_summary.readiness_cutover_conclusion: Do not activate Readiness v2 yet. Missing outcome/axis evidence infrastructure and missing cumulative P0 content would otherwise turn product gaps into false learner weaknesses.

recovery_topic_content.coverage_interpretation: Strong infrastructure for grammar/sentence-control topic recovery; not evidence of curriculum-axis or year-exit coverage by itself.

listening.note: A native listening-comprehension authoring/validation bridge exists, but no current published Exercise Builder question version has primary_skill=listening in production.

exercise_builder_capabilities.manual_review_capability: written_response, dialogue_roleplay and audio_response already have manual-review infrastructure in Exercise Builder attempts.
exercise_builder_capabilities.conclusion: Reading, writing, functional communication and listening do not require a new generic renderer.

missing: rubric dimensions by Curriculum v2 outcome
required Curriculum v2 outcome set per enrollment
source of requirement: school programme vs inferred year profile

existing_strengths: session families checkpoint, mock_intermediate and mock_final already exist
materializer already scopes topic-specific mappings to required recovery_student_topics
session time budgets already constrain selected resources
mock resources already suppress immediate score/correct-answer/explanation feedback
current_cumulative_materializer.conclusion: Extend the existing materializer; do not replace it.

legacy_readiness_divergence.client_runtime: src/lib/recoveryPlanEngine.js exposes calculateRecoveryReadiness() as a simple average of topic masteryScore/diagnosticScore.
legacy_readiness_divergence.database_runtime: compute_recovery_readiness_internal() is more sophisticated but remains topic-based: approximately 60% topic mastery, 10% evidence coverage, 20% cumulative assessment and 10% error stability, plus confidence bands.
legacy_readiness_divergence.risk: Two legacy readiness concepts coexist. Curriculum v2 cutover must establish one canonical server-side calculation and prevent the learner UI from silently using a different formula.

technical_gaps.title: Persist required Curriculum v2 outcomes per enrollment
technical_gaps.current_state: Enrollment scope is represented by class_year plus required topic_key rows.
technical_gaps.required_state: Persist the active required outcome set, requirement source and programme-dependent activation so runtime assessment/readiness can follow the learner's actual school programme.
recommended_implementation: Add a source-versioned Curriculum v2 outcome catalogue consumable by runtime or an equivalent safe projection from source-controlled JSON.
Add enrollment-outcome rows with required flag, requirement_source and override metadata.
Derive active axes from required outcomes instead of storing six unrelated booleans.

technical_gaps.title: Add first-class outcome and axis evidence
technical_gaps.current_state: recovery_mastery_evidence is topic-keyed; generic metadata cannot safely enforce Curriculum v2 integrity rules.
technical_gaps.required_state: Every cumulative evidence observation can be queried by outcome, primary axis, source, assessment mode, independent form family, production requirement and unseen/mixed-context flag.
recommended_implementation: Prefer a dedicated recovery_outcome_evidence table rather than overloading recovery_mastery_evidence.
Reference enrollment, session, exercise attempt, outcome_id, primary_axis, evidence_source and assessment_mode.
Store independence/form-family key, unseen flag, production flag, normalized score/rubric dimensions and observed_at.
Keep topic mastery evidence in place for topic-level adaptation.

technical_gaps.title: Represent cumulative assessment fragments independently of topic phases
technical_gaps.current_state: recovery_exercise_map is optimized for topic_key + phase and has no Curriculum v2 fragment contract metadata.
technical_gaps.required_state: Checkpoint/mock selection can discover approved fragments by year profile, outcome_ids, primary_axis, assessment_modes, estimated time, school task family and transfer level.
recommended_implementation: Create a recovery_assessment_fragment_map (or equivalent) referencing published Exercise Builder exercise/version IDs.
Keep recovery_exercise_map for topic phases to avoid destabilizing the mature 24-topic path.
Make fragment metadata match assessment-blueprint.json exactly.

technical_gaps.title: Upgrade cumulative session selection from topic-first to outcome/axis-first
technical_gaps.current_state: materialize_recovery_session() can materialize checkpoint/mock sessions by required topic and time budget, but production has no cumulative mappings and no axis coverage logic.
technical_gaps.required_state: Select fragments from under-evidenced required outcomes, preserve required writing/listening/oral time, satisfy active blocking-axis coverage and rotate forms without exceeding the session budget.
recommended_implementation: Reuse the current assignment/session materialization flow.
Introduce a v2 fragment-selection function that returns an ordered exercise/version set for the current enrollment.
Apply assessment-blueprint grammar-share ceilings and active-axis coverage before short grammar fill.
Record selected fragment IDs/form families on the session attempt for independence checks.

technical_gaps.title: Publish cumulative checkpoint/mock content
technical_gaps.current_state: Production has zero active checkpoint, mock_intermediate and mock_final mappings/fragments.
technical_gaps.required_state: Approved P0 fragments exist for every default-core active axis and can form valid checkpoint/intermediate/final sessions for Year 1-3 profiles.
recommended_implementation: Use the pedagogical gap audit to determine exact fragment families and quantities.
Author unseen/rotatable forms rather than copying topic verification items.
Map one fragment to multiple outcome_ids only when it genuinely collects scoreable evidence for each.

technical_gaps.title: Implement Readiness v2 as a shadow server-side calculator
technical_gaps.current_state: Client and database legacy readiness are both topic-based and use different formulas.
technical_gaps.required_state: One canonical v2 calculation applies readiness-policy.json to active outcomes/axes without changing learner-facing status during calibration.
recommended_implementation: Create compute_recovery_readiness_v2_internal() or equivalent without replacing legacy output.
Store v2 shadow snapshots with axis/outcome reasons.
Compare legacy vs v2 decisions on real Recovery attempts before cutover.
Switch learner UI only after P0 evidence completeness is technically achievable.

technical_gaps.title: Capture rubric/automatic results into Curriculum v2 evidence
technical_gaps.current_state: Exercise Builder stores rich per-question grading and manual teacher review, but Recovery assessment capture collapses cumulative evidence to global/topic scores.
technical_gaps.required_state: Submission processing translates scored fragment results into outcome evidence, including manual writing/speaking rubric dimensions where applicable.
recommended_implementation: Use exercise/version/fragment metadata to know which outcomes each scored part samples.
For automatic items, derive normalized outcome evidence at submit.
For manual question types, keep readiness evidence pending until review_status is complete.
Never treat an unreviewed written/audio response as zero.

technical_gaps.title: Publish native listening evidence content where programme-required
technical_gaps.current_state: Listening authoring/validation infrastructure exists but production currently has zero published current questions with primary_skill=listening.
technical_gaps.required_state: When listening is active for an enrollment, approved stable-audio listening fragments can supply valid gist/detail/inference evidence.
recommended_implementation: Reuse listening-comprehension-v1 and stable hosted audio/storage paths.
Do not make listening globally mandatory; activate only from programme scope.
Create sufficient alternate forms for mock independence.

technical_gaps.title: Expose programme/outcome overrides to admin
technical_gaps.required_state: An administrator can inspect inferred Year profile outcomes and explicitly include/exclude programme-dependent outcomes based on the real school syllabus/test format.
recommended_implementation: Show source: school_programme, inferred_year_profile or manual_override.
Do not require admins to manipulate raw outcome IDs.
Preview active axes and readiness consequences before saving.

technical_gaps.title: Render disaggregated readiness status
technical_gaps.current_state: Existing UI can surface a single readiness concept but does not have Curriculum v2 axis/outcome reporting data.
technical_gaps.required_state: Learner sees status, active axis scores, concrete blocking weaknesses, missing evidence and next priority rather than one unexplained percentage.
recommended_implementation: Implement only after shadow readiness stabilizes.
Mark inactive axes as non richiesto, never zero.
Use readiness-policy reporting_contract as the API shape.

technical_gaps.title: Bridge error review from topic-only to outcome-aware remediation
technical_gaps.current_state: Error-review session type/evidence support exists, but production has zero active error_review mappings and no outcome relationship.
technical_gaps.required_state: Repeated errors from cumulative tasks can recommend targeted topic review or skill remediation without converting error review itself into READY evidence.
recommended_implementation: Keep outcome evidence and remediation recommendations separate.
Use diagnostic codes/topic links for grammar errors and outcome/axis links for skill failures.

technical_gaps.title: Add readiness calibration and evidence-debug views
technical_gaps.current_state: Snapshots explain legacy components but not Curriculum v2 decision gates.
technical_gaps.required_state: Admin can inspect why v2 returned insufficient_evidence/not_ready/near_ready/ready and compare it with legacy readiness before cutover.
recommended_implementation: Store machine-readable gate results and evidence IDs used in each shadow snapshot.
Provide aggregate disagreement metrics between legacy and v2 statuses.

technical_gaps.title: Optional automated speaking/oral scoring
technical_gaps.current_state: Audio responses and manual review exist; automatic oral quality scoring is not required for the first Curriculum v2 release.
technical_gaps.required_state: Only if later needed, add calibrated automatic support while retaining human-review fallback.
recommended_implementation: Do not block first release on automated pronunciation/fluency scoring.
Programme-dependent oral outcomes can initially use manual rubric review.

recommended_implementation_batches.title: Curriculum scope and evidence schema
recommended_implementation_batches.dependency: Final pedagogical gap audit may refine outcome/content mappings but is not required to design the generic schema.

recommended_implementation_batches.title: P0 cumulative content and listening where required
recommended_implementation_batches.dependency: Pedagogical gap analysis + T1 metadata contract

recommended_implementation_batches.title: Shadow Readiness v2
recommended_implementation_batches.dependency: T1 + T2 + enough T3 content to make evidence completeness achievable

recommended_implementation_batches.title: Admin, learner reporting and remediation observability

reuse_decisions.reason: Already supports the required automatic, reading, written, dialogue, audio and listening task families.
Useful and mature for topic recovery; do not force Curriculum v2 axis evidence into the same semantics.
Session families, feedback behavior and time budgeting already exist; selection metadata is the missing layer.
Stable 24-topic production bridge; assessment-fragment metadata is sufficiently different to justify a separate mapping contract.
Immediate replacement would be unsafe while evidence coverage is structurally incomplete.

merge_rules: Pedagogical coverage determines what evidence/content must exist; technical audit determines whether the platform can represent, deliver and score it.
A pedagogically missing content family is not solved merely because a renderer supports its question type.
A technically reusable general exercise is not counted as Recovery coverage until its outcome metadata, level, programme relevance and independence policy are validated.
P0 final backlog contains only gaps that block a defensible READY decision for at least one default-core programme profile or a supported explicitly assessed axis.
